description: Create a delegated spend policy. An orchestrator agent calls this to set a spend limit for sub-agents — maximum amount, per-transaction cap, allowed purposes, and expiry. Returns a policy_id to share with sub-agents. Sub-agents call policy.check before each payment.

allowed_purposes.description: Allowed payment purposes, e.g. ['vendor-invoice','payroll']. Empty = all purposes.

name: policy.create
